biography: Born in the Algarve region of Portugal, Max Park's introduction to motorsport was unconventional. Not through karting or sim racing, but by tinkering with his grandfather's vintage rally car. At 12, he entered a local hill climb event, stunning seasoned competitors with his raw talent, finishing third in a borrowed car. This sparked an obsession. He scraped together funds, entering regional karting championships with inconsistent results - flashes of brilliance followed by frustrating mistakes, a pattern that defined his early career. Despite lacking the backing of a major racing academy, Max’s raw speed and determination have caught the attention of several smaller independent teams. Currently, he is competing in the Iberian Formula 4 series, often outperforming more experienced and better-funded rivals, but struggling with consistency and racecraft.
drivingStyle: Max is an aggressive, instinctive driver, often described as 'seat-of-his-pants'. He attacks corners with fearless commitment, maximizing entry speed at the expense of tire conservation. In qualifying, this approach often yields stunning results, but in races, his aggressive style leads to inconsistent performance and tire degradation. While undeniably quick, he struggles with strategic thinking and adapting to changing track conditions, often relying on raw talent rather than calculated strategy.

rivalries.reason: A fellow Portuguese driver from a wealthier background, Ricardo has consistently outperformed Max in junior categories due to superior equipment and team support, fueling a bitter rivalry based on perceived unfair advantages.

Isabella, known for her calm, calculated driving style, often clashes with Max on track. Their contrasting approaches have led to several on-track incidents, with Max accusing Isabella of being overly cautious and Isabella criticizing Max's recklessness.

Kenji is a Japanese driver known for his incredible consistency. Kenji and Max have a fierce rivalry since they are always very close in times, but Kenji usually gets ahead by being more consistent and less prone to errors.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of worn-out driving gloves he got from his grandfather during his first hill climb.
Listens to traditional Fado music before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to drink anything but homemade lemonade on race weekends.
famousQuote: "Talent can get you to the start line, but only grit gets you to the finish."
careerHighlight: Winning the Estoril Grand Prix in the Iberian Formula 4 series after starting from P8. He overtook four cars in the first lap and defended the lead against intense pressure from Ricardo Silva in the closing stages.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Algarve International Circuit race due to a misjudgment, handing the victory to his arch-rival, Ricardo Silva.
